title: GopherCon 2016: The Design of the Go Assembler - Rob Pike
summary: Rob Pike's GopherCon 2016 talk on the design of the Go assembler, explaining why Go uses a common assembly language translated to each architecture.
why: HN points to it for background on how the Go toolchain targets many architectures and why its assembler is designed that way.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Its Rob Pike talking about the go assembler and he answers a few of your questions.
